leagueReset.preseasonWarning: The pre-season is an open test: when the League begins, every online hero starts again from zero. Your Pass and your name stay.
leagueReset.title: The League has begun. Everyone started together.
leagueReset.what: The pre-season was an open test. Now that the Season League has begun, every online hero started again from zero at the same moment: nobody keeps an edge from what they did before.
leagueReset.kept: What stays with you: your account, your name and the Adventurer's Pass. Your previous hero was kept on this device only, as a memory, and cannot be brought back into the online game.
leagueReset.pioneer: Thank you for testing! You received the Pioneer Kit: the Pioneer title and the Pioneer frame (decoration only, no stats) and a starter chest with {gold} Gold, {potions} healing potions and {xp} Knowledge Elixir.
leagueReset.chestToast: Pioneer Kit chest: +{gold} Gold, +{potions} healing potions and +{xp} Knowledge Elixir.

welcome.title: Welcome to Camp!

welcome.startTip: Tap Mining, Woodcutting, or Open Hunt to start an activity, then come back later to collect the results.
welcome.saveWarning: Your progress is tied to your account. If you're not signed in, it stays only on this browser/device.

intro.title: Welcome to Arena Idle!
intro.body: We will learn by playing, in a few steps.

points.title: Attribute points
points.body: Spend your points: tap Spend suggested.

dungeon.title: Dungeon
dungeon.body: Go down to floor 5, then retreat to keep the gold of this descent.

hunt.title: Hunting
hunt.body: Open Hunting: it earns materials even while the game is closed.

huntModal.title: Hunting
huntModal.body: Pick a zone and tap Start Hunt.

final.title: Now it's up to you.
final.body: Your hunt is running; come back later to collect and spend each level's points.

garden.title: Garden
garden.body: Plant resources that keep growing over time. Come back later to harvest.

mining.title: Mining
mining.body: Extract ores used in recipes and material production.

woodcutting.title: Woodcutting
woodcutting.body: Gather wood used in recipes and processed materials.

deliveries.title: Orders
deliveries.body: Deliver materials in exchange for Gold and other rewards. Materials are consumed when you accept an Order.

reforge.title: Reforge
reforge.body: Trade resources to generate new attributes on a piece of equipment.

sockets.title: Sockets and Gems
sockets.body: Sockets let you insert gems into equipment to modify its attributes.

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Every {n} levels you earn a skill point. Spend it on Warrior, Guardian or Hunter: everything is automatic.

gear.wooden_club_d: A lump of wood. Better than nothing.
gear.bronze_dagger_d: Short and cheap, but it really cuts.
gear.iron_short_sword_d: Honest iron, well balanced for a new fighter.
gear.steel_greatsword_d: A broad, heavy blade: every swing takes the whole body.
gear.gilded_warblade_d: A war blade with a golden edge, made to find weak spots.
gear.dragon_flameblade_d: Forged with dragon scales: the steel still seems to smolder inside.
gear.voidsteel_blade_d: Voidsteel that leaves a trail of embers where it passes.
gear.abyssal_greatblade_d: An abyssal blade, dark and hot as a live coal.
gear.ragged_clothes_d: Patched rags. They protect you from nothing.
gear.bronze_leather_d: Tanned leather with bronze plates: simple cover for the first floors.
gear.iron_chainmail_d: Iron links that dent under a blow but do not tear.
gear.steel_plate_d: Full steel plate, so firm it throws part of the blow back at the attacker.
gear.gilded_aegis_d: A gilded aegis: far too pretty to be this well armored.
gear.dragon_scale_armor_d: Dragon scales stitched one by one. Warm to the touch, hard as stone.
gear.voidsteel_plate_d: Voidsteel plate, cold and quiet as a starless night.
gear.abyssal_bulwark_d: An abyssal bulwark: whoever wears it seems to carry a wall.
gear.ring_vitality_d: A ring of warm light: wounds close a little at a time while the fight goes on.
gear.amulet_swiftness_d: A light amulet that quickens every swing of the arm.
gear.berserker_crest_d: A crest of fury: critical hits become far more violent.
gear.bronze_helm_d: A plain helm hammered out at the village forge.
gear.iron_helm_d: Heavy and steady. It takes the first blow for you.
gear.steel_helm_d: Well-tempered steel with a reinforced visor.
gear.gilded_helm_d: It shines so bright that enemies hesitate before striking.
gear.voidsteel_helm_d: Forged from a metal that reflects no light at all.
gear.abyssal_helm_d: Black horns and a constant whisper inside the helm.
gear.leather_gloves_d: Soft and plain, good for gripping anything.
gear.iron_gauntlets_d: Every punch lands like a hammer blow.
gear.gilded_gauntlets_d: A champion's finery that also breaks bones.
gear.voidsteel_gauntlets_d: Your fingers seem to vanish inside them.
gear.abyssal_gauntlets_d: Obsidian claws that feel the enemy's pulse.
gear.leather_boots_d: Soles worn from the long walk to the dungeon.
gear.iron_greaves_d: They guard your shins and steady your step.
gear.steel_greaves_d: Light enough to run in, hard enough to hold the line.
gear.gilded_greaves_d: Every step rings like a pocket of coins.
gear.abyssal_greaves_d: The ground seems to give way a little less beneath them.
gear.copper_ring_d: It tints your finger green, but it brings luck.
gear.silver_ring_d: Thin and cold, it glints at the slightest move.
gear.gold_ring_d: Heavy, with an eye engraved on the band.
gear.ruby_ring_d: The stone pulses like a tiny heart.
gear.obsidian_ring_d: Volcanic glass, sharp even on the inside edge.
gear.abyssal_ring_d: A circle of darkness that fits on one finger.
gear.demon_fang_dagger_d: Torn from a Glade demon. It still bites.
gear.demonhide_vest_d: Tanned demon leather: warm to the touch, hard as a hoof.
gear.bloodvein_plate_d: Red veins run through the metal and throb in battle.
gear.riftwalker_boots_d: Whoever wears them never steps twice in the same place.
gear.shadow_hood_d: It bends the light around the wearer's face.
gear.abyss_heart_ring_d: It beats slowly, in time with something far larger.
gear.bonecrusher_maul_d: Too heavy to be elegant, too accurate to be ignored.
gear.goblin_king_crown_d: Small, crooked and studded with stolen gold teeth.
gear.warchief_gauntlets_d: Scored with a name for every battlefield.
gear.lich_soul_ring_d: It holds a soul that does not want to leave.
gear.overlord_greataxe_d: They say the last king of the dungeon swung it one-handed.
gear.bronze_hatchet_d: A woodcutter's axe sharpened in a hurry: hits harder, misses the weak spot.
gear.iron_battleaxe_d: Too heavy for feints, too sure to miss.
gear.steel_greataxe_d: Two hands, one swing, and the conversation is over.
gear.gilded_waraxe_d: A broad blade with a gilded edge: made to split, not to pierce.
gear.voidsteel_cleaver_d: The void edge cuts without a gleam and without a flame.
gear.abyssal_reaver_d: An axe from the abyss: every blow weighs like a sentence.
gear.bronze_buckler_d: Small and round, it protects what it can.
gear.iron_shield_d: An honest shield, dented at the rim.
gear.steel_kite_shield_d: Every blow that lands on it comes back with interest.
gear.gilded_shield_d: It reflects the light, and whoever strikes it, in equal measure.
gear.voidsteel_shield_d: It swallows the force of a blow without a sound.
gear.abyssal_shield_d: A dark wall that gives back what it takes.
gear.bone_ward_d: Ribs lashed with sinew: improvised, but stubborn.
gear.warden_bulwark_d: Heavy, cold, and always facing whoever tries to flee.
gear.goblin_lucky_coin_d: A scratched coin polished by endless rubbing: gold seems to follow it home.
gear.warchief_totem_d: Carved with the names of the fallen: every blow echoes a war cry.
gear.lich_phylactery_d: A vial of trapped soul: the life that leaks from your enemies drips back into you.
gear.overlord_sigil_d: A seal of command: precise blows grow more precise, and crueller.
gear.season_emblem_d: The crest of one who finished the season: a little more gold and a slightly stronger blow.

camp.title: Base Camp
camp.resting: Pick an activity: your hero hunts, mines and farms while you are away.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.noCertificateHint: Items made before the market or outside the server stay yours and can be used, but they are not tradable.
inventory.certUnverified: Certificate not confirmed by the server

tradeReason.rarity: Only Epic, Legendary or Unique pieces can be sold
tradeReason.bound: Bound to the account: it has been equipped
tradeReason.uncertified: Made without the server: it cannot be sold

inventory.wornAboveLevel: Above your level: requires level {n}. It stays equipped, but swap it for a piece you can use.
inventory.bindConfirm: Equipping binds this item to you. It can no longer be sold on the market. Equip anyway?
inventory.hint: Select an item to see details
inventory.needAnotherTool: You need another tool of this type before salvaging this one
inventory.salvageBonus: Item salvaged! Rare material bonus received!
inventory.gemsReturn: {n} socketed gem(s) go back to your stock
inventory.salvageRounding: Each recipe ingredient returns {pct}% of its quantity, rounded down with no minimum: low-quantity ingredients may not be recovered. The random rarity bonus is separate and not guaranteed.
inventory.salvageEmpty: No guaranteed materials for this recipe.
inventory.lapidarExplanation: Lock one extra stat (kind and value stay) and roll the others again. Only on Epic or Legendary pieces of tier {tier} and up, from level {lvl}. Every earlier lapidation on this piece makes the next one {g}% of the first price dearer (up to {max} lapidations). Rarity, refine level, sockets and durability do not change.
inventory.lapidarNeedTier: Lapidar needs a piece of tier {n} or higher.
inventory.lapidarNeedRarity: Lapidar needs an Epic or Legendary piece (two or more extra stats).
inventory.bagFullUnequip: Bag full! Free up space before unequipping this piece.
inventory.maxCapacityReached: Maximum capacity reached for this version.
inventory.expandFailed: Not enough Gold to expand the bag.
inventory.salvageBagFull: No room for what salvaging returns. Make room first.
inventory.useIn_reforge: Reforging rare pieces (in the piece's detail)
inventory.useIn_use: Can be used straight from here
inventory.useIn_auto: Used automatically in the Dungeon and Hunting
inventory.leftBehindPreview: Inventory full: {n} would be left behind if you collect now. Make room first.

statsPanel.tapHint: Tap a stat to see where it comes from.
statsPanel.cpNowHint: CP with the elixirs running now. The CP used to compare with the recommendations stays the permanent one.
statsPanel.defenseRaw: Raw defense (sum) {raw} removes {pct} of the damage

consumables.refine_catalyst_d: Guarantees success on the next gear upgrade
consumables.expedition_ticket_1h_d: Advances an active Delivery by 1 hour
consumables.expedition_ticket_2h_d: Advances an active Delivery by 2 hours
consumables.expedition_ticket_4h_d: Advances an active Delivery by 4 hours
consumables.knowledge_elixir_d: +25% XP for every monster defeated in Hunting, for 4 real-time hours. Only one at a time; it does not apply to the Dungeon
consumables.knowledge_elixir_running: A Knowledge Elixir is already active. Wait for it to end before drinking another.
consumables.greater_elixir_d: Heals 50% of max HP in the Dungeon — scales with your character
consumables.strength_elixir_active: Elixir of Strength active for 30 minutes!
consumables.stoneskin_tonic_d: +10% defense in combat for 30 real-time minutes (adds to your gear and RES)
consumables.fortune_tonic_d: +20% gold from Hunting and the Dungeon for 60 real-time minutes
consumables.gatherer_brew_d: +25% ore and wood (and profession XP) for 2 real-time hours
consumables.whetstone_oil_d: Restores 30% durability to the equipped weapon and armor
consumables.whetstone_oil_active: Weapon and armor restored by 30% durability!
consumables.whetstone_oil_full: Weapon and armor are already at full durability.
consumables.fertilizer_d: Use on a growing plot: removes 50% of the remaining time (once per planting)
consumables.repair_kit_d: Restores 60% durability to the equipped weapon and armor
consumables.repair_kit_active: Weapon and armor restored by 60% durability!
consumables.master_repair_kit_d: Fully restores the durability of the equipped weapon and armor
consumables.armor_polish_d: +5% defense in combat for 30 real-time minutes (adds to Stoneskin)
consumables.hunter_lure_d: Use during a hunt: +10% chance for the uncommon and rare materials of that zone for 60 real-time minutes
consumables.hunter_lure_active: Lure active in this zone for 60 minutes!
consumables.hunter_lure_needs_hunt: The Lure only works during a hunt: start hunting and use it again.
consumables.prospector_tonic_d: +10% ore and wood (and profession XP) for 2 real-time hours; adds to the Gatherer Brew
consumables.forge_seal_d: Toggle it in the Forge: the next piece forged comes out Epic or better. It is only spent if the forge happens. The piece comes out bound, so it cannot be traded.
consumables.stash_deed_d: Use it to enlarge the stash by 5 slots, for good. The total limit is 20 extra slots.
consumables.gold_pouch_d: Open it to receive exactly its value in Gold, for good. It can be sold to other players once the market opens.

forge.title: Forge
forge.catalystHint: Consumes 1 Refine Catalyst and guarantees this upgrade succeeds
forge.sealHint: The next piece comes out Epic or better ({n} held)
forge.socketHint: Select a gem below to insert
forge.noSockets: No sockets available (Requires Tier 1 Bronze or higher)
forge.deepNote: Past +8 (pieces of tier {tier} and up): each level adds {b}% of the base stat. Chance {c9}% for +9, {c10}% for +10, {c11}% for +11 and {c12}% for +12. A failure never destroys the piece, but on the +10, +11 and +12 attempts it can cost a level ({d10}%, {d11}% and {d12}%; never below +8). The Catalyst only works up to +8.
forge.upgradeDropped: Failed, and the piece fell back to +{m}
forge.lapidarDone: Lapidated: the other stats were rolled again
forge.reforgeExplanation: Rerolls ALL extra stats of the selected piece: the result may improve or get worse. Rarity, refine level (+N), sockets and durability do not change, and other copies are not affected. Each attempt consumes everything below (stock / cost).
forge.gearFull: Bag full ({n}). Discard, salvage or expand your bag first.
forge.noCategoryRecipes: No recipes available in this category.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.strDesc: +{flat} damage and +{pct}% of weapon damage per point
attributes.vitDesc: +{hp} Max HP per point (+{perLevel} per level)
attributes.agiDesc: Attacks {ms} ms faster per point (up to {max} points)
attributes.resDesc: -{red}% damage taken per point and +{hp} Max HP

w_heavy_blow.name: Crushing Blow
w_heavy_blow.desc: Every {every} hits of yours, a crushing blow deals +{n}% damage.

w_fury.name: Fury Strike
w_fury.desc: Every {s} s of combat, {hits} extra rapid hits of {n}% of the damage each.
w_fury.trigger: Every {s} s: {hits} extra hits of {r1}% / {r2}% / {r3}% damage.

w_bleed.name: Bleed
w_bleed.desc: Your hits make the enemy bleed: {n}% of the hit per second, up to {s} s after your last hit. Adds to the weapon's burn.

w_weapon_master.name: Weapon Master
w_weapon_master.desc: +{n}% of the equipped weapon's base damage.

w_devastating_strike.name: Devastating Strike
w_devastating_strike.desc: Every {k}th Crushing Blow becomes a Devastating Strike: damage multiplied by {mult} instead of its normal bonus.

g_thorns.name: Thorns
g_thorns.desc: +{n}% damage reflect, added to the armor's and the shield's.

g_second_wind.name: Second Wind
g_second_wind.desc: Regenerates {n}% of max HP per second in combat.

g_firm_stance.name: Firm Stance
g_firm_stance.desc: -{n}% damage taken on Dungeon boss and mini-boss floors and in Hunting promotion and Target fights.

g_block.name: Block
g_block.desc: {n}% chance to block a hit completely. Counterattack: your next hit after a block deals +{c}% damage.

g_last_bastion.name: Last Bastion
g_last_bastion.desc: A lethal hit leaves you at {hp} HP and heals {heal}% of max HP. Once per Dungeon run; in Hunting, once every {s} s of combat.

h_light_step.name: Double Strike
h_light_step.desc: {n}% chance for a hit to strike twice (the echo deals {e}% of the damage).

h_greed.name: Greed
h_greed.desc: +{n}% Gold from the Dungeon and Hunting, outside the gear cap.

h_scent.name: Scent
h_scent.desc: +{n}% materials from Hunting. Unique pieces and relics are unchanged.

h_quick_learner.name: Quick Learner
h_quick_learner.desc: +{n}% XP for every monster defeated in Hunting.

h_great_luck.name: Great Luck
h_great_luck.desc: +{hunt}% unique piece chance in Hunting and +{boss}% unique piece and relic chance from Dungeon bosses.

ui.title: Skills
ui.firstPoint: Your first skill point arrives at level {n}.
ui.respecBody: Take back all {n} points of {set}? You choose everything again.
ui.respecFree: Cost: none, the first time is free.
ui.respecBattle: You cannot respec or switch sets during a Dungeon battle.
ui.respecSessions: A running Hunting, Mining or Woodcutting session keeps the stats it froze when it started; the change applies from the next session.
ui.passOnly: The second set is an Adventurer Pass perk.

invites.passHint: Invite {n} friends who buy the Pass and get a free Pass

home.idle: Your hero is resting at camp. Start an activity to make progress.

dungeon.defeatKept: The floors you cleared already count toward your progress, and everything you collected is yours.
dungeon.guidedSubtitle: Retreat now to keep the gold of this descent.
dungeon.defeatKeptNone: No floor was cleared this time, but nothing you already had was lost.
dungeon.defeatCpLow: Your hero is still weaker than this floor asks for.
dungeon.defeatCpOk: Your power was within the recommendation: it was a close fight.
dungeon.defeatTipHunt: Tip: hunt to gain levels and gather materials, forge better gear and come back stronger.
dungeon.defeatTipRetry: Tip: try again with potions in your bag (the hero uses them automatically) or improve your gear in the Forge.

dungeon.depthsLocked: Defeat the Floor 100 boss to open the Depths.

dungeon.tensionSubtitle: Decide now: bank the reward safely, or push your luck.

hunting.title: Hunt
hunting.stopHint: Ends the hunt and opens the rewards screen.
hunting.busyOther: Your hero is on an Open Hunt. Stop hunting before starting another activity.
hunting.claimFirst: Claim your Hunting reward before starting another.
hunting.switchClaimFirst: Hunt ended. Claim the reward, then pick the new zone.
hunting.sessionFrozen: Your gear or attributes changed since this Hunt started, but it keeps the ones it started with. To use them, stop the Hunt and start a new one. Elixirs, tonics and the Pass used now already count from now on.
hunting.uniquesHeld: Inventory full - unique pieces are held here until you free a slot.
hunting.uniquesServerNote: Unique items are rolled by the server when you collect the reward.
hunting.uniquesHeldToast: Inventory full! Make room to receive the rest - it stays held.
hunting.depthExplain: Deeper: stronger monsters that give more XP, and more refined and noble materials.
hunting.subLevelNext: {n} of {x} wins at this level. {left} more to unlock the test for the next level.

hunting.capLinePass: Stores up to {n} h (with the Pass: {p} h)
hunting.subLevelXp: Every level of this zone pays +{n}% hero XP for each monster defeated.
hunting.xpKillExplain: Every monster defeated gives the hero XP: the faster you defeat them, the more you earn, and monsters of a higher level or depth give more. Beyond a certain pace, extra speed pays less and less.
hunting.subLevelNeedCp: To move up to the next level of this zone you need {cp} CP.
hunting.promotedNone: The zone level did not go up this hunt.
hunting.leftBehindToast: {n} items were left behind: the inventory was full.
hunting.collectedGoesTo: This goes into your inventory when you claim.
hunting.invMissing: {n} slots short - these would be left behind:
hunting.invMissingOne: 1 slot short - this would be left behind:
hunting.invFullIn: Inventory full in ~{t} (estimate at the current rate)
hunting.owedHeld: Items you already owned from the old Hunting Pouch did not fit yet: they stay held here until there is room.
hunting.leftBehindWarning: Inventory full - {n} items are left behind when you claim. Open the inventory first to make room.
hunting.overflowWarning: At the estimated rate the inventory fills in ~{t}, before the {h} h storage limit: the rest would be left behind.
hunting.invExplain: Hunt loot goes straight into your inventory when you claim. Without room, the excess is left behind.

notify.title: Arena Idle

deliveries.title: Orders
deliveries.note: Accepting an order takes the materials right away and sends the delivery out. It keeps going with the game closed.
deliveries.busy: A delivery is in progress. The other orders stay visible so you can plan the next one.
deliveries.legacyNote: Expeditions started before Orders finish and pay out as usual. No new ones can be started.

expedition.title: Expedition
expedition.exp_epic_d: An 8-hour dispatch for the biggest rewards.

mining.title: Mining
mining.busyDungeon: Your hero is mining. Cancel or collect resources at the Mine before entering combat.
mining.busyBattle: You can't start mining with an active dungeon run. Retreat from battle first.
mining.busyOther: Your hero is mining. Stop that before starting another activity.

woodcutting.title: Woodcutting
woodcutting.busyOther: Your hero is woodcutting. Stop that before starting another activity.
woodcutting.busyBattle: You can't start woodcutting with an active dungeon run. Retreat from battle first.

garden.title: Garden

stash.title: Stash
stash.note: Keeps items without using inventory slots. Recipes, orders and upgrades only use what is in the inventory.

merchant.confirmSellPart: Confirm: sell {n} of {m}? (today's budget limits the sale)
merchant.capped: the day's budget limits the sale
merchant.notBought: The merchant does not buy this item.
merchant.budgetSpent: The merchant buys nothing more today. The budget returns at midnight.
merchant.explain: Prices are low on purpose: this is for making room, not for earning gold. The budget renews at midnight.
merchant.nothing: Nothing in the inventory the merchant buys.

wholesale.title: Wholesale Merchant
wholesale.locked: Opens after you beat the boss of Dungeon floor {n}.
wholesale.explain: Buys materials in bulk with no daily Gold limit, but pays little: {rate}% of the normal merchant's price. Nothing is sold on its own: you choose what to sell.
wholesale.curve: The first {n} units of each material pay the full wholesale price; after that every block of {b} units pays {d}% less, down to {f}% of the normal merchant's price at the lowest. It starts over at midnight.
wholesale.fromBag: Buys from the inventory, not from the Stash. Materials only.
wholesale.nothing: No material in the inventory that the wholesaler buys.
wholesale.confirmTotal: Total: {n} units for {g} Gold. This cannot be undone.
wholesale.rareTitle: This list has a rare material
wholesale.rareWarn: Other players would pay more for this on the market, once it opens. The wholesaler pays the minimum. Sell anyway?
wholesale.worthless: Would pay less than 1 Gold: nothing was sold.
wholesale.fullHint: No room? The wholesaler buys the excess for little. You decide what to sell.

pouch.title: Gold Pouch
pouch.explain: Turns Gold into a Gold Pouch: an item that can be sold to other players once the market opens. Anyone can create Pouches. Minimum amount: {min} Gold; the fee is {free}% in Gold, paid on top ({fee}% for Adventurer Pass owners); at most {n} Pouches per day.
pouch.openExplain: Any player can open a Pouch they hold and receive exactly its value. Opening cannot be undone.
pouch.passFee: The Adventurer Pass halves the fee: {fee}% instead of {free}%.
pouch.failLimit: Daily Pouch limit reached. It resets at midnight.
pouch.failGold: Not enough Gold: it takes the value plus the fee.
pouch.failBag: No room in the inventory for the Pouch.
pouch.confirmOpen: Open for good? +{g} Gold, no way back
pouch.none: You have no Gold Pouches in the inventory.

events.title: League events
events.preseasonLead: The League will have events from day 25 to 60: one at a time, taking turns between Hero and Profession. See the calendar below.
events.buff: Event bonus: +{n}% Hunting XP, ends in {t}
events.capNote: All event bonuses together give at most +15% Hunting XP.
events.pickHint: Pick ONE profession: it gets +25% XP this week. The pick holds for this week only.
events.desc_invasion: Waves that grow. Every run of fights won without falling pays more Hunting XP (+1% per 50, up to +10%) and the enemies get stronger every 100 wins in a row. A defeat ends the wave.
events.desc_target_hunt: A rare target shows up every 300 fights won: twice the HP and 1.5 times the damage. Whoever beats it gets +8% Hunting XP for 1h30.
events.desc_dungeon_race: Each Dungeon boss beaten pays 120 Gold and +8% Hunting XP for 4 h.
events.desc_grand_delivery: Each order collected during the event gives +10% Hunting XP for 3 h. The order still spends its materials: choose what to deliver.
events.desc_time_rift: The enemies hit 25% harder, and a streak of fights won during the automatic hunt pays XP (+1% per 25, up to +10%).
events.desc_mining_fever: +25% ore in every Mining session (and with it, Mining XP).
events.desc_crafts_festival: +15% profession XP in Mining, Woodcutting and the Garden.
events.desc_profession_week: Pick ONE profession: it gets +25% XP for the week.
events.desc_final_race: In the last 5 days, the day you collect all four daily goals you get +5% Hunting XP for 24 h.

tradeable.badgeTitle: Tradeable material: the same as the normal one, but it can be sold to other players
tradeable.desc: Identical to the normal material in every recipe, order, refine or sale to the merchant. The only difference is that this one can be sold to other players on the Market. Only the server creates tradeable materials, when you collect.
tradeable.detailLine: Tradeable: it can be sold to other players.
tradeable.normalDesc: Normal material. On some collections the server rolls tradeable units of the same material.
tradeable.merchantSame: The merchant pays the same price as for a normal material. Other players pay what the seller asks.
tradeable.useText: This will spend {list}. These materials can be sold to other players. The game spends the normal ones first and only uses tradeable ones when the normal ones run out.
tradeable.useNpcTitle: Sell tradeable material to the merchant?
tradeable.useNpcText: This will sell {list} to the merchant for the same price as a normal material. Other players would pay more on the Market.
tradeable.useRetry: The inventory changed while you were deciding. Try again.
tradeable.blocked: No connection to the server: tradeable materials cannot be spent right now. Normal ones still work.
tradeable.prefFirst: Spend tradeable ones before normal ones
tradeable.prefFirstHint: Off (the default): recipes, orders and refining spend the normal ones first and only use tradeable ones when the normal ones run out, so you never spend by accident what you could sell.
tradeable.serverNote: Tradeable materials exist only in the online version, with an account.
tradeable.waiting: {n} tradeable {name} waiting for room in the inventory.
